mechanics.name: Boon: Illumination
mechanics.currentEffect: While next to a Totem, use the Active Ability button to bless it, creating a unique Boon Totem that combines all of your equipped Boons. Survivors within its 24-metre range see the Auras of Chests and Generators. While you have a Boon Totem, you bless Totems 150/175/200% faster.
activation: Bless a Totem to create your Boon Totem.
Aura reading applies to Survivors within the Boon's 24-metre range.
The blessing-speed bonus requires you to have an active Boon Totem.
Ends/deactivates when: Aura reading ends outside the Boon's range or when the Boon is snuffed.
Ends/deactivates when: The blessing-speed bonus ends when you no longer have an active Boon Totem.
mechanics.patchNote: Latest live balance change (10.2.0): Replaced the 6/8/10% Blessing/Cleansing bonus with 150/175/200% faster Blessing while the perk owner's Boon Totem is active; Aura effects remain.
mechanics.plainEnglishSummary: Your Boon reveals nearby Chests and Generators, and having an active Boon makes your future blessing actions dramatically faster.
mechanics.oncePerTrialOrOtherLimits: One active Boon Totem per Survivor; all equipped Boon effects are combined on that Totem.
specialInteractions: The 10.2.0 speed bonus applies to Blessing only; the former separate Blessing/Cleansing speed bonus was removed.

editorial.summary: Your Boon reveals nearby Chests and Generators, and while it stays lit you bless future Totems up to 200% faster.
useCases: Relocate an already-active Boon much faster when a dedicated Boon build needs to follow the active objective area.
Provide local Generator and Chest Aura information inside the Boon radius.
Support Steadfast-centered or multi-Boon packages where frequent relocation is actually part of the plan.
counters: The Killer can snuff the Boon and remove the active infrastructure.
The speed bonus is worded around having a lit Boon Totem; post-snuff re-blessing remains a controlled-test question.
Relocating a Boon can cost more objective time than simply staying on a Generator.
pros: Very large blessing-speed bonus for relocation while a Boon remains active.
Can be a strong infrastructure component in a dedicated Boon package.
cons: Low global value outside a dedicated Boon build.
Does not justify moving a Boon when the relocation itself loses more time than it saves.
Post-snuff rebuild behavior should not be claimed until controlled testing settles it.
analysis: Boon: Illumination has a clear split between global value and archetype value. Its global rank stays low because the perk needs a meaningful Boon package before faster relocation matters.

Inside a Steadfast-centered or multi-Boon build, the relocation speed can be a real piece of infrastructure. Live gameplay showed that relocating the Boon can be extremely fast, but also showed the opportunity-cost problem: moving the Boon for modest Generator value can lose more time than simply repairing.

The current wording ties the blessing-speed bonus to already having a lit Boon Totem. The post-snuff case remains a mechanics test, so v15 does not describe fast rebuilding after a snuff as established behavior.
This is exactly why v15 separates global rank from archetype ratings: a low-global perk can still be a strong component of a specialized package.
editorial.verdict: Low global priority, potentially strong Boon-package infrastructure. Judge it as a specialist component, not a standalone information perk.

archetypeRatings.note: Strong infrastructure component when an active Boon must follow generator clusters; this does not assume fast post-snuff rebuilding.
